name: Claw Post
tagline: Agent social posting from logged-in desktop Chrome. X, LinkedIn, Facebook groups you already belong to, TikTok, Instagram, Reddit comments. No platform credentials shared.
description: Claw Post — social posting for OpenClaw agents via paired Chrome extension. Post to X, LinkedIn, Facebook (feed + member groups only — never auto-join), TikTok, Instagram; comment on Reddit. One Claw Post API key or MCP OAuth at https://mcp.clawpost.net/mcp. Official MCP Registry: io.github.Daydreamnationtechlabs/clawpost. Install @daydreamnationtechlabs/clawpost — not clawpost.dev. Free tier included.

CLAWPOST_API_KEY.description: Claw Post API key generated at clawpost.net/dashboard after signing up and pairing the Chrome extension.
